title: 月面连续电源设计单位的来源与边界
verified_content: NASA specified a conceptual electrical output of40kW and reactor mass below6metrictons; operatinggoal10years; article describes development concepts, not a qualified deployed product.
limits: 6t is a design mass budget adopted at the published requirement boundary, not measured hardware mass.
Parallel replication at MW-scale, shielding, heat rejection, siting, reliability and installation remain engineering assumptions.
Output is stipulated firm continuous power; no equivalence to unbuffered solar nameplate capacity.
